calibration: Reuse saved V6_local from DST0/DST50 and saved V6 from DST25 if manifests, bounds, starts, optimizer, fixed OCV25 and Q25 reference are identical. Verify source code/input hashes. No calibration data or hyperparameter choices from 10/40C.
base_model: Same continuous 1s ZOH ECM-2RC V6: fixed independent OCV_mean25, initial RC0, causal SOC=z0-net_Ah/Qeff; Q reference is measured low-current Q25. Target data used only after parameter predictions and GP hyperparameters have been persisted.
branch_alignment: Use saved branches sorted fast-to-slow by tau. Predict these labels across calibration temperatures, then jointly swap R1/R2 and tau1/tau2 if predicted ordering crosses; report swaps.
transforms: Natural log for R0/R1/R2 and tau1/tau2; identity for Qeff and z0.
P1: Nearest nominal calibration T; ties choose lower T. Transfer all seven parameters.
P2: Piecewise linear interpolation in nominal Celsius T of transformed parameters; no extrapolation at test T.
P3: OLS on all three calibration points: y=a+b/(T_C+273.15) for log R and log tau; y=a+b*T_C for Qeff,z0. No target observations.

P4.structure: Seven independent scalar GPs; deterministic mean equals fitted P3; residual RBF in nominal Celsius T.
P4.standardization: Scale each transformed parameter by max(population std of its three calibration values,1e-6); zero centering unnecessary because P3 mean is subtracted.
P4.kernel: K_ij=sigma_f^2*exp(-(T_i-T_j)^2/(2*ell^2)); standardized residuals; fixed diagonal numerical jitter variance 1e-8. No fitted observation noise.
P4.objective: Negative log marginal likelihood plus 0.5*((log ell-log25)/2)^2; weak Gaussian prior on log ell. Optimize log sigma/log ell using L-BFGS-B, maxiter1000, ftol1e-12, gtol1e-8; select minimum objective among successful fixed starts.
P4.prior: log ell ~ Normal(log(25 C),2^2). Penalized marginal likelihood/MAP, not unpenalized MLE. User confirmed.
P4.point_prediction: Posterior mean in transformed coordinates, inverse transform then project physical bounds; voltage at these central parameters supplies P4 MAE (not posterior-average voltage).
P4.sample_joint: For each independent parameter draw joint latent posterior at T=[10,40] with covariance across T. Condition on both temperatures satisfying physical bounds by rejection per parameter. Keep200 accepted joint draws, combine independent parameter draws into200 seven-parameter sets. Maximum1000000 proposals per parameter then explicit failure, no fallback.
P4.bands: Pointwise empirical2.5/97.5 percentiles of200 voltage trajectories; coverage=count(lower<=measured<=upper)/N. Same200 parameter sets reused for FUDS/US06 at each temperature.
P4.uncertainty_limit: Only GP interpolation uncertainty conditional on plug-in P3 mean/kernel and exact saved NLS parameter points. No NLS fit uncertainty, trend uncertainty, measurement noise or voltage discrepancy. Nominal95% need not achieve95% empirical voltage coverage.

constraint_policy: User confirmed: P1/P2/P3/P4 central predictions projected to physical bounds; report every projected coordinate. Posterior samples conditioned to bounds via rejection, not clipped. Parameter plots show Gaussian unconditioned marginal bands separately from physical bounds; test-conditioned samples stored for audit.
parameter_plots: Calibration points only at0/25/50; P2/P3/P4 central curves on0..50C and P4 unconditioned Gaussian transformed2.5/97.5% marginal band, inverse transformed, with explicit labeling; bounded central lines and physical limits.
floor: Read-only prior V6 transferred from25C, same target trajectories and MAEs.
ceiling: Read-only prior V6_local at10/40C; oracle reference ONLY, never enters calibration or GP optimization. Not a guaranteed mathematical MAE ceiling.

decision.fraction: (MAE_floor-MAE_method)/(MAE_floor-MAE_ceiling); signed and unclipped. Nonpositive denominator flagged unavailable and cannot pass.
decision.positive: For every one of four conditions (10/40C x FUDS/US06), max(fraction_P2,fraction_P3,fraction_P4)>=0.50; best may differ per condition. P1 excluded from criterion.
decision.P4_uncertainty: Calibrada iff coverage is inclusively between0.85 and0.99 in ALL four conditions. Diagnostic only, does not change main verdict.

preservation: All previous result folders and reports hashed before/after and unchanged. New artifacts only in results/a123_temperature_interp and report_temperature_interp.md.
output: Complete manifests with calibration fit provenance, GP attempts/hyperparameters, transformed posterior mean/covariance, accepted parameter samples/rejection counts, central parameters/clips/swaps, point predictions, voltage bands, coverage, metrics CSV/TEX, parameter/voltage plots and report.
